refinements.description: 发动[强化特殊技]或[连携技]时，[普通攻击]和[冲刺攻击]造成的电属性伤害提升50%，持续10秒，15秒内最多触发一次。
refinements.descriptionEn: When launching an EX Special Attack or Chain Attack, Electric DMG from Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks increases by 50% for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

basic.name: 普通攻击：热血上工操
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的混合攻击，造成物理伤害；
第四段攻击为[打桩攻击]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 mixed attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG.
The 4th hit is a Piledriver Attack.

special.name: 特殊技：兄弟，转起来！
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
对前方直线区域内敌人发动[打桩攻击]，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a Piledriver Attack against enemies in a line in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：兄弟，突破天际！
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Smash the Horizon, Bro!
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，若点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，若点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
对前方直线区域内敌人发动多段[打桩攻击]，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，安东将进入[爆发状态]；在[爆发状态]下，安东会使用更加强力的招式，造成大量电属性伤害，并随招式命中目标，逐渐消耗能量，持续至能量耗尽。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launches several Piledriver Attacks at enemies in a line in front of him, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Anton enters Burst Mode after using this skill. When in Burst Mode, Anton's attacks become more powerful, dealing massive Electric DMG while continually consuming Energy upon hitting an enemy. Burst Mode remains active until his Energy is depleted.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：回敬拳击
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续重拳，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Continuously strikes enemies in front with heavy punches, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：转转转！
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方地面进行大范围[打桩攻击]，对区域内的敌人造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a Piledriver Attack onto the ground in front of him over a large area, dealing massive Electric DMG to enemies within range.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：转转转转转！
ultimate.nameEn: Ultimate: Go Go Go Go Go!
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方地面进行大范围[打桩攻击]，对区域内的敌人造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a Piledriver Attack onto the ground in front of him over a large area, dealing massive Electric DMG to enemies within range.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：并肩作战
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续重拳，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Continuously strikes enemies in front of him with heavy punches, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：钢腕
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：极限突进
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动[电钻攻击]并以[打桩攻击]收尾，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Launches a Drill Attack that ends in a Piledriver Attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 安东发动[打桩攻击]时，招式造成的伤害提升24%，发动[电钻攻击]时，招式造成的伤害提升40%。
facts.textEn: When Anton uses his Piledriver Attack, the skill's DMG is increased by 24% and when he uses his Drill Attack, the skill's DMG is increased by 40%.

cinema.name: 热身运动
cinema.description: [电钻攻击]命中敌人时，能够额外回复能量；同一招式内，该效果最多为安东回复5点能量。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Drill Attack hits an enemy, Anton gains additional Energy, up to a maximum of 5 Energy per skill use.

cinema.name: 气势如虹
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]进入[爆发状态]时，获得等同于安东7.5%生命值上限的护盾；在[爆发状态]下进入接战状态或换入前场时，将刷新护盾效果，15秒内最多触发一次；退出[爆发状态]时，该护盾效果结束。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Anton uses his EX Special Attack and enters Burst Mode, he gains a Shield that equals to 7.5% of his Max HP. While in Burst Mode, entering combat or switching in reapplies the Shield effect. This effect can trigger once every 15s. The Shield dissipates when Burst Mode ends.

cinema.name: 轮岗培训
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 一起燃烧！
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，全队角色暴击率提升10%，持续12秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Anton uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, all squad members' CRIT Rate increases by 10% for 12s.

cinema.name: 全栈专家
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 突破极限
cinema.description: [打桩攻击]造成暴击时，[普通攻击：热血上工操（爆发状态）]和[闪避反击：过载钻击（爆发状态）]造成的伤害提升4%，最多叠加6层，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Anton's Piledriver Attack triggers a critical hit, his Basic Attack: Enthusiastic Drills (Burst Mode) and Dodge Counter: Overload Drill (Burst Mode) deal 4% more DMG for 30s, stacking up to 6 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

[爆发状态]下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的混合攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；

Unleashes up to 3 mixed attacks in front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
During the 2nd Drill Attack and 3rd Piledriver Attack, press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] to extend the skill duration.

向前方进行撞击，造成物理伤害。
